system.description:
As part of the requirements for casting this jutsu, your weapon must be under the effects of a jutsu that would provide it an increase to damage in any way, such as the jutsu Lightning Release: Lightning Kings Mantle, or Fire Release: Flame Coat, etc.

You take your already enhanced weapon and funnel more powerful chakra within it, causing it to radiate intense black chakra before releasing it as a wave of black chakra filling a 60-foot cone. All creatures within range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapon's damage] + 4d12 damage of the damage type of the jutsu that buffs your damage and has their maximum hit points reduced by the damage dealt for the next minute on a failed save, or half much damage on a success. The maximum hit point reduction effect can be removed by a medical effect that removes conditions of A-Rank or higher.

Chain 3: A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is Stunned until the end of their next turn due to the intense shock from the force of the jutsu passes.
